name: 1-3:Subterranean Den
short:
Nobody has
come back from
beneath
the Central
Dome alive...
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 Nobody that we've sent
 beneath the Central Dome
 has come back alive.
 Please go down and
 investigate.
※ Job can be joined
 while in progress.

I've been waiting for
you, <name job> <name hero>.

To sum up what's
happening:

Since the beasts around
the Central Dome have
been exterminated,

we've been able to send
investigation teams in to
check things out.

However, the door to the
Dome itself won't open.

But we were able to find
a teleporter that will
send us below the Dome.

However, our advance
team went to investigate
and hasn't returned!

Somehow or another, we
need to get into the
Central Dome!

The council decided that
sending in more troops is
too dangerous, and so...

They've asked for the
best hunters to go check
things out.

And so, I've chosen you
for the job.

Find a way underneath the
Central Dome, and find
out what happened!

My secretary, Irene,
has the details. Please
speak to her.
...I'm counting on you.

Please speak to
Irene, my secretary.
Rico...!

No, I didn't say
anything. Please continue
your research.

A huge dragon? Surely you
jest... You actually saw
such a creature?

And... The dragon, did it
attack you!?

You believe the native
animals on Ragol attacked
Pioneer 1...

To defend their
territory? It's possible.
But why all of a sudden?

Once again, you've done
an excellent job.

For your efforts, please
accept a <color 4>reward<color 0>!

Speak to Irene. She'll
give it to you.

I'll keep you in mind for
future jobs, as well.

I look forward to seeing
more of your skill in
action.

Speak to Irene to receive
your <color 4>reward<color 0>.

Why did this all have to
happen so suddenly?

We don't have enough
info! We must count on
your help.

For now, though, please,
go and relax.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!

Here are the details of
the current mission.

Use the teleporter near
the Central Dome to go
below and investigate.

I believe that the
Principal has already
told you this, but

nobody has returned from
the area underneath the
Dome.

I have a feeling that
this might be a very
dangerous mission.

Please do everything that
you can to make sure you
survive.
That is all.
Good luck.

I heard that you found
messages from Rico.
But she's still missing.

Please find her. The
sooner the better!
Please!

It seems Rico saw some
suspicious things, so
she went to investigate.

Oh, I hope she knows
what she's doing…

A huge dragon?! Did Rico
face it? What about the
people of Pioneer 1?

The Principal is
waiting. Please give him
your report.
Great work, as always.

Here. Let me give you
this <color 4>reward<color 0>.

I hope that you're able
to put it to good use!
Welcome back.

So, there was a giant
dragon there...

It's hard to imagine 
something like that
living on Ragol!

I wonder if we'll
encounter more of them…

Why don't you go and rest
up a bit, for now?

You've already finished
this quest.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

Oh, you're already
carrying too many items,
it seems.

Please come back when
you have some more room.
You received a <color 4>reward<color 0>!

The Lab has checked out
the probe data that you
recovered.

Something made the native
wildlife of Ragol turn
violent.

According to Pioneer 1's
reports, the wildlife was
thought to be docile.

What could have possibly
happened to change this?

As a scientist, I find
Ragol's ecological system
to be fascinating...

But as a citizen, I'm
rather frightened.
A huge dragon!?

Pioneer 1 never mentioned
this in their report...
How can this be?

Is Ragol such a dangerous
place!?

What made the normally
docile animals become
so aggressive?

Could it be a natural
thing? I guess that's one
possibility.

Perhaps Pioneer 1 made a
false report. I don't
know why they would.
Isn't it possible though?

It's just a rumor, but
they say that they found
a sole survivor

from Pioneer 1 near the
Central Dome.

Her name is Rupika, and
she's apparently not only
a military officer, but

also a nobleman's
daughter. But I have my
doubts about that.

That's because the girl's
a Newman.

A Newman would typically
be of low social
standing.

For a Newman to be both a
soldier and an aristocrat
is, well...

It'd be really rare. Not
impossible, maybe, but
I've never heard of it.

The dragon's weak spot
should be its head.

Direct your attacks on
its head when it lowers
it.

I was against the
immigration!

If a planet dies, the
people should die along
with it, right?
